description: This file contains helper functions related to creating multiple pack files and managing git configurations to avoid automatic garbage collection and repacking during bulk pack creation in a git repository.

methods.name: create_packs
methods.description: Creates a specified number of packs, each containing a single blob, using perl to generate pack contents and git fast-import to import them.

methods.name: setup_many_packs
methods.description: Configures git settings to disable automatic garbage collection and pack auto-limiting, then creates 500 packs.
